objective: Fix Android keyboard occlusion of Cluster Home Important Notice fields and Save while retaining all other Cluster functions.
productionBaselineEvidence: On 2026-11-07 GitHub main at 0fd0d0bd696b8900311c9c835c021f36f6c28f1e was inspected and compared to dev branch. This is a verified source baseline only, not a live production OTA fingerprint. DEV-only patch pending actual Android verification.
chosenApproach: Keep a platform-aware KeyboardAvoidingView inside the native editor Modal; make input fields independently scrollable and Save a fixed footer above the system safe-area inset.
selectionRationale: The global root keyboard wrapper cannot adjust a separate native Modal. Targeted React Native layout changes preserve backend logic, Android native runtime and every unrelated screen.
alternativeApproaches: Global Android windowSoftInputMode and root-shell change: rejected due to risk of regressions on Connect and other native screens and possible new build.
Manually measure keyboard window height and absolutely reposition footer: rejected due to OEM keyboard variance and lifecycle race risk.
Local KeyboardAvoidingView plus scrollable form and safe-area pinned Save: selected as smallest isolated solution.
acceptanceChecks: Infinix X6852: with keyboard visible, all fields can be reached by scrolling and focus stays readable.
With keyboard shown and hidden, Save stays tappable above Android phone navigation and is not overlaid.
All seven Cluster form kinds retain existing input semantics, admin guard and backend save logic.
TypeScript, focused regression and other CI checks pass before creating RC.
Staging-user device behavior must be verified before any production OTA.
preserveBehaviors: Important Notice persistence, EMERGENCY priority and admin-only restrictions
Event, Task, Poll, Resource, Recognition and About save workflows
Cluster Home navigation, customization, ads and other widgets
Canonical Android v28 runtime 1.3.2 and production OTA isolation
